title: संविधान
palette: warm chamber palette, polished teak, brass lamps, long window light

scenes.n: संविधान लिखना केवल अनुच्छेद लिखना नहीं था। यह तय करना था कि राज्य और नागरिक के बीच संबंध क्या होगा।
beats: A drafting room with a long teak table covered in papers, brass lamps burning along its length, tall windows behind, nobody seated, wide shot
A blank preamble page centred on a teak desk under a brass lamp, warm light, overhead shot

scenes.n: व्यक्ति के अधिकार क्या होंगे? सरकार की सीमाएं क्या होंगी?
beats: Looking straight down at a bare desk holding a single sheet of paper, a fountain pen and a pair of spectacles, warm lamplight, overhead shot
A pair of scales and a small brass rod balanced on a fulcrum on teak, warm light, close shot

scenes.n: किसी नागरिक के साथ भेदभाव होने पर कानून क्या करेगा? और सबसे महत्वपूर्ण— क्या भारत में हर नागरिक कानून की नजर में बराबर होगा?
beats: A courtroom bench and an empty witness box in an Indian high court, polished teak and brass rails, long window light, wide shot
A polished brass balance mounted above a courtroom bench, warm light, medium shot
A row of identical chairs of exactly equal height along a chamber wall, warm light, wide shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर की सोच में लोकतंत्र केवल चुनाव नहीं था।
scenes.p: A rural polling station on election day, a queue stretching out of frame, a wooden ballot box on a table, dust and warm light, wide shot

scenes.n: उनके लिए लोकतंत्र एक सामाजिक जीवन-पद्धति भी था। जिसमें स्वतंत्रता हो। समानता हो। और बंधुत्व हो।
beats: Three small brass weights of identical size set in a row on dark polished wood, single warm light source, close shot
Three identical clay cups filled to exactly the same level on teak, warm light, close shot

scenes.n: यही तीन शब्द उनकी सोच में बार-बार दिखाई देते हैं। Liberty. Equality. Fraternity.
beats: Three identical clay lamps burning side by side on a teak table in a dark room, their flames steady, close shot
Three equal flames reflected in a polished teak surface, dark room, close shot

scenes.n: अगर स्वतंत्रता है लेकिन समानता नहीं... तो स्वतंत्रता कुछ लोगों के हाथों में विशेषाधिकार बन सकती है।
beats: A brass balance scale with one pan raised high and the other resting on the table, warm lamplight, deep shadow, close shot
One tall figure and several short figures cast as shadows on a warm wall, uneven, medium shot

scenes.n: अगर समानता है लेकिन स्वतंत्रता नहीं... तो व्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता समाप्त हो सकती है।
beats: A brass balance scale held exactly level but clamped in a vice, warm lamplight, deep shadow, close shot
A brass wire bird cage on a teak table, its door shut, warm lamp, close shot

scenes.n: और अगर दोनों हैं लेकिन बंधुत्व नहीं... तो समाज में विश्वास और एकता कमजोर हो सकती है।
beats: Two chairs set facing each other at a distance across a wide teak floor, an unbridged gap between them, wide shot
Two plank ends of a broken bridge not quite meeting over a gap, warm light, medium shot

scenes.n: इसलिए डॉ. आंबेडकर के लिए लोकतंत्र केवल राजनीतिक व्यवस्था नहीं था। यह सामाजिक संबंधों का भी प्रश्न था।
beats: A village meeting at dusk, people of different households seated together in one circle, lanterns being lit, warm light, wide shot
Many different hands joined around a single lamp on a table, warm light, overhead shot

scenes.n: 4 नवंबर 1948 को संविधान सभा में बोलते हुए उन्होंने 'constitutional morality' की आवश्यकता पर जोर दिया।
beats: A speaker's lectern in a full assembly chamber lit by a single overhead shaft, members at tiered desks turned towards it, wide shot
A page headed by a blank title standing on a lectern under a shaft of light, warm, close shot
Members at tiered desks all turned toward one lit lectern, seen from the side, wide shot

scenes.n: अर्थात... संविधान सिर्फ कागज पर मौजूद होना पर्याप्त नहीं। उसे चलाने वालों में संवैधानिक मूल्यों के प्रति सम्मान भी होना चाहिए।
beats: A thick bound document lying closed on a desk beside a pair of empty spectacles, warm lamplight, deep shadow around, close shot
A constitution volume held open by two hands, warm lamp, the reader unseen, close shot
A brass lamp lighting an empty ceremonial chair beside a closed volume, warm light, medium shot

scenes.n: 25 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान सभा में उनका अंतिम महत्वपूर्ण भाषण आया। भारत अगले ही वर्ष गणतंत्र बनने वाला था।
beats: The Constituent Assembly chamber on its last working day, members standing at their desks, papers gathered, light from the dome, wide shot
A gavel resting for the last time on a sounding block, papers gathered around it, a shaft of light, close shot
Tall chamber doors thrown open onto bright daylight, members' silhouettes, wide shot

scenes.n: लेकिन डॉ. आंबेडकर उत्सव के बीच एक चेतावनी दे रहे थे।
scenes.p: A celebration in an assembly lobby, garlands and clasped hands, everyone seen from behind, bright daylight through tall doors, medium shot

scenes.n: उन्होंने कहा कि भारत राजनीतिक रूप से समानता की ओर बढ़ रहा है, लेकिन सामाजिक और आर्थिक जीवन में असमानता बनी हुई है।
beats: Looking straight down at two maps of the same country laid side by side, one marked evenly and one marked in uneven patches, overhead shot
A staircase where the lower steps are crowded and the upper steps empty, a warm shaft of light, wide shot
A balance scale tilting despite equal ballot slips in both pans, warm light, close shot

scenes.n: एक व्यक्ति... एक वोट। एक वोट... एक मूल्य। लेकिन समाज में?
beats: Two identical ballot slips side by side on a table, one flat and one held down under a heavy brass weight, hard side light, close shot
A single ballot slip pinned flat under a heavy brass weight on teak, warm hard light, extreme close-up

scenes.n: हर व्यक्ति का मूल्य बराबर नहीं माना जा रहा था। यही उनका सबसे बड़ा विरोधाभास था।
beats: A row of people standing shoulder to shoulder against a plain wall, all seen from behind, the floor beneath them stepped at different heights, wide shot
A line of identical silhouettes on a floor that steps to different heights, warm backlight, wide shot

scenes.n: भारत राजनीतिक लोकतंत्र में प्रवेश कर रहा था। लेकिन सामाजिक लोकतंत्र अभी अधूरा था।
beats: A grand staircase in a government building, the lower steps crowded and the upper steps empty, a hard shaft of light from above, wide shot
A half-built staircase rising into open sky, the top steps missing, warm light, wide shot

scenes.n: और डॉ. आंबेडकर जानते थे— अगर सामाजिक और आर्थिक असमानता बहुत लंबे समय तक बनी रही... तो राजनीतिक लोकतंत्र भी खतरे में पड़ सकता है।
beats: A hairline crack running through a polished stone floor, brass lamplight raking across it, deep shadow, close shot
A crack widening across a stone wall beneath a grand hall, warm raking light, medium shot
A single loose foundation stone pulled slightly out of a wall, warm lamp, close shot

scenes.n: यह चेतावनी 1949 में दी गई थी। लेकिन इसकी चिंता आज भी समझी जा सकती है।
beats: A stone foundation inscription panel left deliberately blank, weathered edges, raking afternoon light, close shot
A weathered milestone by a modern road at dusk, its face left blank, warm light, close shot

scenes.n: 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान अपनाया गया। और 26 जनवरी 1950 को भारत एक गणराज्य बना।
beats: A vast parade ground on Republic Day 1950, crowds along the avenue, flags without emblems, cold bright January light, wide shot
A flag being hoisted up a pole at dawn on Republic Day, seen from below, cold bright light, wide shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर की जिंदगी का एक सबसे बड़ा अध्याय पूरा हुआ। लेकिन... उनका संघर्ष खत्म नहीं हुआ।
beats: An office at the end of a long working day, papers squared into a single stack, the chair pushed back, low evening light, medium shot
A single lamp left burning over a cleared desk in a dim office, low evening light, medium shot

scenes.n: क्योंकि अब उन्हें एक ऐसे मुद्दे का सामना करना था जो भारतीय परिवार, विवाह, संपत्ति और महिलाओं के अधिकारों से सीधे जुड़ा था। Hindu Code Bill.
beats: A fresh unbound sheaf of draft legislation set down on an empty desk, a hand withdrawing, cold morning light, close shot
A family register and a marriage garland set together on a desk, cold morning light, close shot
A tall pair of doors marked by a blank plate, one just opening, cold light, medium shot
